scope: Screenshot capture, persistence attribution, and URL-history completion in the extension. No native browser or release was run in this lane.

diagnosis.confirmed_source_failure: ScreenshotsView knew the clicked tab ID but passed assignedTabId:null; take_screenshot then resolved the active tab later. Its captureVisibleTab call was window-scoped, as were all full-page tiles, and neither checked Chrome documentId. Same-URL reload and active-tab change could therefore accept or persist bytes from another page under the stale tab URL.
diagnosis.persistence_boundary: All three writers use persistScreenshot; wbx_screenshot is URL-keyed historical lookup and has no documentId column. The capture document ID is included in uploaded file metadata and successful take_screenshot output. The index row retains the captured document's URL/title.

correction: The screenshot button pins its initiating tab and Chrome top-frame document ID in ToolContext before invoking the shared handler.

Window-scoped visible, region, and full-page tile capture checks active tab and document ID before and after capture; full-page scroll scripts target the original document ID and restore that document's scroll on failure.
The tab-targeted CDP path checks its original document after capture and stores original page metadata.
The gallery explicitly labels URL history, and a user capture that finishes saving after later navigation reports that it belongs to the earlier page.

verification.behavioral_red: Guarded d59-screenshot-red2-0928: naive shared boundary returned bytes after same-URL document replacement and different active tab; two assertions failed, one baseline passed. This was a boundary red, not a replay of the unmodified handler.
verification.behavioral_green: Guarded d59-screenshot-tests2-0928: six tests passed, including real take_screenshot.run rejection on same-URL replacement and different visible tab, plus full-page scroll restoration on failure.
verification.generated: Guarded d59-screenshot-catalog2-0928 and d59-screenshot-docs-0928 passed. Initial catalog run failed because RECORDS_GUIDE_SOURCE was unset; rerun used the existing aidream source.

limits: Chrome captureVisibleTab returns a window image without atomic tab or document identity. Checks detect a change observed before or after the API call; a switch away and back entirely inside one capture call cannot be certified.
No native UI capture, same-URL reload, persistence row, or release verification was run here. EXT-D-0059 remains incomplete until native acceptance and the other census ranks finish.
